paper.title: Variance-Aware Feel-Good Thompson Sampling for Contextual Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Variance-aware contextual bandits with general reward function class (weak adversary with variance revealing)
unmapped: noise eps_t is sigma_t^2-subgaussian conditionally on history with time-varying sigma_t revealed to the agent at the start of round t
realizable general function class F (f_* in F) with mean rewards in [0,1]
regret depends on generalized decoupling coefficient dc and log|F|
settings.definition_quote: In step $t$ over a total of $T$ steps, the agent first receives the context $x_t$ and the action set $\cA_t\subset\cA$. The agent then selects an action $a_t\in\cA_t$ and receives randomized reward $r_t=f_*(x_t, a_t)+\epsilon_t$, where $f_*:\cX\times\cA_t\to[0, 1]$ ... We assume that $\sigma_t^2$ is revealed to the agent at the beginning of step $t$

unmapped: per-round noise level sigma_t revealed to agent at start of round t
settings.definition_quote: $f_{\btheta}(x, a)=\langle\btheta, \bphi(x, a)\rangle\in[0, 1]$, $\Theta\subset\{\wb\in\RR^d:\|\wb\|_2\le1\}$ is the parameter space

symbols.dc: generalized decoupling coefficient dc_{lambda,epsilon,T}(F) with lambda=1, epsilon=T
symbols.F_card: cardinality of the finite function class F

source.label: theorem:regret_upper_bound
source.quote: Suppose that Assumption \ref{assumption:subgaussian_noise} holds, the function class $\cF$ has finite cardinality, and the prior distribution $p_0$ is the uniform distribution on $\cF$. ... Then the total regret of \FGTSVA~satisfies $\EE[\Regret(T)]\lesssim\sqrt{(1+\Lambda)\dc_{\lambda, \epsilon, T}(\cF)\log|\cF|}+\dc_{\lambda, \epsilon, T}(\cF)$.

results.notes: Regret defined through f_* means, so pseudo-regret. Lambda here is sum of subgaussian parameters sigma_t^2 (upper bounds 4x conditional variance). Remarks 7-9 specialize: linear Õ(d sqrt(Lambda)+d), deterministic O(dc), sigma_t=1 gives Õ(sqrt(T dc log|F|)+dc).

symbols.Z: 1 v sup max_t Z_t, a potential quantity (<= log|F| for finite class with uniform prior)

source.label: theorem:general
source.quote: Suppose that the parameters are set as in \eqref{eq:parameters}, and the hyperparameters are $\lambda=1,\quad\epsilon=\alpha^{-2},\quad c=2\sqrt{Z/\dc_{\lambda, \epsilon, T}(\cF)}$. Then the total regret satisfies $\EE[\Regret(T)]\le\frac94\sqrt{(\alpha^2T+\Lambda)Z\dc_{\lambda, \epsilon, T}(\cF)}+\dc_{\lambda, \epsilon, T}(\cF)$.

results.notes: General version covering infinite classes; tuning c needs Z and dc.

source.label: lemma:Z
source.quote: For the linear reward function class where $\Theta$ is the unit ball, we have $-\log p_0(\cF_\delta(f_*))=\tilde\cO(d)$ according to \citet{zhang2022feel}. Therefore, the regret of \FGTSVA~in linear contextual bandits is $\tilde\cO(d\sqrt{\Lambda}+d)$, even if $\cF$ is not the $\epsilon$-net.

results.notes: Also stated in Remark 7 (via epsilon-net). Combines Lemma 14 with Theorem 12 and Proposition 4.
